title: Q-IMPROVE-fe-speculation: Prefetch the next likely page with speculation rules so clicks between core pages feel instant
body:
**Owner:** uiux-manager
**Trigger:** improve --run
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::speculationrules
**Prediction:** uiux:findings_total < 0 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Kind: frontend. Baseline uiux:findings_total = 0. Settled 7 days after it closes: kept if uiux:findings_total moved the right way, else replaced.

Before closing: run the UI/UX audit on the changed pages (`python3 -m foundation uiux --tick` on the platform, the seed's uiux audit in a tenant), keep Core Web Vitals inside budget (LCP <= 2.5 s, CLS <= 0.1, INP <= 200 ms), and pass the human-voice check on every changed line of copy. A change that adds a blocking finding is reverted, not waived.

**Closing probe:** grep:site/worker.js::speculationrules

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T20:04:04Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
